objective: Cross-sectional equal-stock MSE within month and equal-month mean across training months. Intercept unpenalized. Same fixed source preprocessing for all arms; no hyperparameter search.
scope: Original 214-input stock-feature linear ridge anchor, NOT a neural-network run or final confirmation. Existing panel is conditioned on future_validation_eligible and state_history_complete; evaluates this selected sample only. Actual total monthly stock return minus contemporary RF is outcome, not input. No target moments, beta labels, target error fields or environment labels enter features.
inference: Exploratory monthly HAC12/Holm10 for 2 overall gains and 8 environment interactions; HAC6/24/60 sensitivity. Q1 report loss and zero-return-relative R2 descriptively; no causal or beta/lambda interpretation.
stop_rule: One fixed run. No alpha, input or window changes in response to results. Verify hashes, keys, timing, finite features and rolling calendar support; fail closed otherwise.
